new.s: Which organisation released the Emissions Gap Report 2026 titled 'The Point of Return'?
new.x: The Emissions Gap Report is an annual UNEP report; its 17th edition in 2026 was titled 'The Point of Return'.

new.s: Ophiorrhiza shidiensis and Ophiorrhiza pemae, new plants from Arunachal Pradesh, were discovered by Madras Christian College and which institution?
new.x: The two Rubiaceae plants from Vijaynagar, Changlang were described by the Botanical Survey of India and Madras Christian College, Chennai.

new.s: Researchers of which university described Osbeckia assamensis, a new plant from Manas National Park?
new.x: Osbeckia assamensis was described by Namita Nath of Gauhati University and Barnali Das of Pragjyotish College.

new.s: Which State had the highest tiger population in the All India Tiger Estimation 2022?
new.x: Madhya Pradesh had 785 tigers, ahead of Karnataka (563) and Uttarakhand (560).

new.s: How many stages does the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) for Delhi-NCR have?
new.x: GRAP has 4 stages, from Poor (AQI 201-300) to Severe Plus (above 450).

new.s: The Aletsch Glacier, the largest and longest glacier in the Alps, is in which country?
new.x: Aletsch is a valley glacier in Switzerland and part of the Jungfrau-Aletsch UNESCO site.

new.s: Which sector accounts for the largest share of India's methane emissions?
new.x: As per India's Third Biennial Update Report (2016 data), agriculture gives about 74% of India's methane.

new.x: Phase III brought 9 cheetahs from Botswana on 28 February 2026, after Namibia (8) and South Africa (12).

new.s: Impatiens nagorum, a new balsam named after the Naga tribes, was found in which State?

new.s: Which was the first tiger reserve of Maharashtra?
new.x: Melghat, in the Gavilgarh Hills of the Satpuras, is Maharashtra's first tiger reserve.

new.x: The Greenhouse Gas Bulletin is a WMO report; its October 2025 edition put CO₂ at 423.9 ppm for 2024.

new.s: Who became the first Indian to win the Kenton R. Miller Award of IUCN-WCPA in 2025?

new.s: Which area has the largest population of dugongs in India?
